values.binNote: HealPerSecond is a per-second rate (base [100/150/200], +0.5xAP); the wiki's per-tick value divides this by 4 ticks per second (0.25s interval), giving base 25/37.5/50 and +0.125 AP per tick — numbers agree once divided by 4.

values.quote: healing herself and nearby allies every {{fd|0.25}} seconds
values.binNote: No bin row states the tick interval directly; it is implied by dividing the tooltip total heal (base 300/450/600 over 3s, i.e. HealPerSecond*Duration) by the per-tick value (25/37.5/50) shown in the wiki's leveling table, giving 12 ticks over 3 seconds = 0.25s per tick. The bin has no explicit tick-rate field.

mechanics.claim: The heal is a channel that ticks every 0.25 seconds for up to 3 seconds, and is interrupted by attacking, casting, moving, or most item uses.
Monsoon can be blocked by spell shields.
The knockback pushes enemies back based on proximity, up to 875 units, over 0.5 seconds, but not through terrain.
mechanics.quote: knocks back all nearby enemies to up to 875 units over {{fd|0.5}} seconds based on their proximity, though not through terrain
